title: Slow down before December
headline: Slow down before December
caption:
The fairy lights are up in the studio. ✨

Clitheroe's Christmas lights switch-on is coming up next Saturday, and the town is starting to feel festive.

Before the busy weeks begin, here's a gentle way to slow down this weekend:

1. Sit side-on to a wall, then lie back and swing your legs up so they rest against it.
2. Let your arms relax by your sides and your shoulders soften into the floor.
3. Stay for 2 to 3 minutes, breathing slowly in through your nose and out through your mouth.

A cushion under your hips can make it comfier. Come down slowly, and skip it if it doesn't feel right for you.

When you're ready for a little more, our reformer Pilates classes in Clitheroe are a calm, welcoming way to start the week.

Plan next week's class through the link in our bio 🗓️

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
